entries.en: Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
entries.zh: 新增 `/claude-api api-version`，可把 Claude API 代码迁移到 API 版本 `2026-10-21`

entries.en: Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
entries.zh: 新增 `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry 事件：每当权限规则、自动模式、安全检查、钩子或沙箱拦截、询问或退回一次工具调用时都会记录

entries.en: [VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写自动停止时（15 秒未识别到语音或达到 2 分钟上限），麦克风按钮上会显示提示，说明原因并告知已识别的文字会保留

entries.en: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review
entries.zh: [Code Review] 新增 `@claude review stop`（也可用 `off` 和 `pause`），可结束拉取请求上的 `@claude review always` 订阅且不触发新的审查

entries.en: Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
entries.zh: 改进无法解析的工具调用的恢复：Claude Code 现在会最多重试两次，再以错误结束本轮

entries.en: Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work
entries.zh: 改进同时启动的分叉子智能体：每个都会被告知哪个是自己的任务，大大减少互相抢做对方工作

entries.en: Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
entries.zh: 改进浏览器登录：登录完成后立即显示成功页面，不再等待账号资料加载

entries.en: Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
entries.zh: 改进云端和自托管运行器会话的网页搜索错误：带原因的 403 拒绝现在会显示该原因，而不是笼统的「Authentication error」

entries.en: Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
entries.zh: 缩短了桌面应用某个 MCP 服务器无法连接时云端会话的首次回复时间

entries.en: Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads
entries.zh: 缩短了记录中含大量粘贴图片或 PDF 读取的会话的 Remote Control 连接时间

entries.en: Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use
entries.zh: WebSearch 额度用完时给 Claude 的提示，现在也会告诉它不要通过浏览器或电脑操控去搜索引擎查询

entries.en: Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)
entries.zh: `axScreenReader` 设置和 settings `env` 块里的 `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` 改为只在用户、托管或 `--settings` 设置中生效（自 2.1.305 起）

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：检出钩子默认 30 分钟后被停止并使会话初始化失败；如需更久，调大 `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` 或设为 `0`

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：为 Anthropic 托管 git 生成的证书文件改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书；会有一行 `[runner:warn]` 显示被排除的数量

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes
entries.zh: [VSCode] 「仍在别处打开」提示现在也涵盖扩展重启后遗留的 Claude 进程，这种进程通常会在约 10 分钟内自行结束

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
entries.zh: [VSCode] 语音听写改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书

entries.en: [VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings
entries.zh: [VSCode] 扩展自身的请求改为像 CLI 一样过滤受信任证书，并信任环境变量或用户设置中指定的 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 文件

entries.en: Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` 且模型是带 `[1m]` 后缀的别名（如 `opus[1m]`）时，请求因找不到模型而失败

entries.en: Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
entries.zh: 修复在自定义 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关和 Foundry 上仍发送不起作用的 `prompt-caching-scope` beta 请求头

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 登录钥匙串锁定时，`claude -p` 中 MCP 服务器显示「需要认证」；现在会说明原因，解锁后下次运行无需重新登录即可连接

entries.en: Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
entries.zh: 修复 macOS 或 Linux 电脑在 MCP 服务器连接过程中休眠时，服务器被报告为超时、并在无界面运行中一直失败

entries.en: Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
entries.zh: 修复连接在调用中途断开时 HTTP MCP 工具调用被发送两次；现在只有只读或幂等的工具才会重试

entries.en: Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
entries.zh: 修复后台任务运行时，某一轮有时没有带上 SDK MCP 服务器的最新工具就开始

entries.en: Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
entries.zh: 修复读取大量 PDF 页面、图片或其他大型工具结果的轮次中出现的部分「Autocompact is thrashing」错误

entries.en: Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
entries.zh: 修复云端会话重启后 `/autocompact` 恢复为默认窗口

entries.en: Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted
entries.zh: 修复云端或自托管运行器会话重启后，用 `/clear` 清空的对话有时又回来

entries.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
entries.zh: 修复 Claude 应用网关会话中 `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` 被忽略

entries.en: Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set
entries.zh: 修复设置了 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` 时，位于 Claude 应用网关后的 Claude Desktop 会话遥测数据被拒收

entries.en: Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
entries.zh: 修复 `/permissions` > 最近拒绝 不显示被拒绝的 shell 命令，以及自动模式的本地分类器在检查重试命令时忽略在此处的批准；现在批准某一行会显示命令本身，而不是它的描述

entries.en: Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions
entries.zh: 修复 `/help` 和 `/` 命令菜单对 `/claude-api` 等内置技能显示面向模型的长描述，而不是简短描述

entries.en: Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
entries.zh: 修复流式响应下子智能体记录里出现占位的 token 用量和空的停止原因

entries.en: Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
entries.zh: 修复 API 确认模型超过 5 秒时，通过 Agent SDK 的 `setModel()`（及基于它的应用）切换模型被拒绝；Claude Code 现在最多等待 15 秒

entries.en: Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
entries.zh: 修复通过已连接应用停止的后台命令（如桌面应用归档空闲会话）被报告为用户停止；提示现在会写出其输出文件

entries.en: Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
entries.zh: 修复 Cowork 云端会话中网站返回 4xx 状态或 robots.txt 拒绝时 WebFetch 报工具错误；现在和本地会话一样作为正常结果返回

entries.en: Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab
entries.zh: 修复桌面应用 Code 标签页中，直接配置的 GitHub MCP 服务器的写入工具弹出表单后关闭却什么都没创建

entries.en: Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
entries.zh: 修复服务器已关闭复用连接时，Artifact 工具读取因连接重置而失败

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复使用 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 的会话把之前会话留在克隆目录中的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 提交进去

entries.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
entries.zh: 自托管运行器：修复在检出钩子期间归档或重新排队会话、或停止运行器时，钩子进程仍在运行并占用运行器名额

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复用「Show more」展开的长提示覆盖整个聊天面板；置顶的提示现在最多占面板 40% 并可滚动

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复含 LaTeX 公式的列表项或表格单元格的一部分，在富文本编辑器中被粘贴成新的列表或表格

entries.en: [VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
entries.zh: [VSCode] 修复仅在 `~/.claude/settings.json` 中设置 `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` 时，语音听写在 TLS 检查代理后失败；现在也会遵循 `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
entries.zh: [云端会话] 修复搜索仍在进行时仓库选择器显示「No repositories match」；现在会显示「Searching…」直到结果返回

entries.en: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts
entries.zh: [云端会话] 修复自托管环境中「Waiting for a runner」状态显示被截断；使用按需运行器时，现在会从你最后一条消息开始计时并显示失败的尝试
